st-wb-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of West Bengal
st-wb-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in West Bengal, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-wb-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-wb-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-wb-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of West Bengal

st-wb-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-wb-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of West Bengal
st-wb-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in West Bengal, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-wb-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-wb-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-wb-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of West Bengal
st-wb-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of West Bengal (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-wb-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-wb-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-wb-assembly.name: West Bengal Legislative Assembly
st-wb-assembly.description: The unicameral state legislature of West Bengal (294 seats), elected by first-past-the-post for a 5-year term.
st-wb-assembly.notes: Two-phase poll (23 & 29 April 2026) with one seat repolled 21 May 2026; results declared 4 May 2026. BJP won 208 of 294 seats in initial tally per election-results reporting; the assembly's own infobox (post seat adjustments/by-elections) shows Government (BJP) 207, Official Opposition (DTC, the post-defeat breakaway from AITC) 65, and other opposition (MAITC/INC/LF+/CPI(M)/AISF/AJUP) 20, with 2 seats vacant.
